title: 第4章 问询
novel_title: 长生：我体内有一片坟陵
content_zh:
修炼室内。

    苏牧盘膝坐在蒲团上，缓缓睁开双眼。

    经过五天修炼，他彻底稳固了炼气六层的境界。

    相比炼气五层，此刻他的经脉凝实了倍余，丹田气海的容量更是扩充了五倍多。

    “仅仅一层之差，便有如此大的变化，远胜四层和五层之间的差距……”

    苏牧满面感慨之色，握了握拳，感觉浑身充满了劲力。

    “以我眼下的身体状态，哪怕坟陵失效不似推测那般，突破七层应该也用不了多久，瓶颈总不至于每阶都有。”

    苏牧满怀憧憬，仿佛看到了将来筑基的一天。

    他低头瞧了瞧坐下的石台，暗道：“只要进了内门，有了聚灵阵，进境速度定能快不少。”

    在外门，说是修炼室，其实就是一个相对隐秘的石室，只有内门修炼室才配置有阵法，能聚拢天地灵气，辅助修行。

    “砰砰砰~”一阵急促的敲门声突然响起。

    苏牧霍地扭头看向石门，便听得陆永正的声音传来：“苏师兄！执法殿有事找你！”

    他目光闪了闪，暗自吸了口气，起身出了石室到的客厅，去将门户打开。

    门口站着三个人，除了陆永正，另外两名男子身穿执法殿专属黑色制服，相貌看着比较年轻。

    苏牧先是一怔，继而眼中闪过诧异，连忙拱手道：“不知两位师兄寻我何事？”

    跟着，他又摆手作请道：“三位请屋里说话。”

    两名执法殿弟子进入客厅，扫视着室内环境，其中个高男子说道：“我叫陈决，他是方一隆，奉命调查望月峰亲传弟子李构暴毙一案，过来例行询问。”

    陆永正则依旧站在门口，院子里还有不少弟子朝这边张望。

    苏牧扫了眼那些探头探脑的弟子，心中暗道：也好，越多人看到自己配合问讯，越显得坦荡。

    “好的，好的。”他点头应着，快步走去桌前着手泡茶，边道：“两位师兄尽管问。”

    陈决说了句‘不必忙’，却是开门见山道：“上个月三十一日，早间辰时到巳时两刻这段时间，你在何处？”

    苏牧拿着茶壶动作一顿，故意咽了下口水，想了一会才道：“辰时三刻我在库房，然后回返院舍，大概巳时一刻回到修炼室，直到次日将近午时才出门。”

    陈决一张方脸眉眼狭长，不苟言笑给人精明之感，闻言挑眉问：“辰时三刻？为何记得这么清楚？”

    苏牧‘哦’了一声道：“前一日我在库房盘点到深夜，整理完账目喝了点酒，一不小心睡着了，直到第二天，陆师弟过来将我叫醒，当时说了时间。”
content_en:
In the training room.

    Su Mu sat cross-legged on the futon and slowly opened his eyes.

    After five days of practice, he had completely stabilized the sixth level of Qi refining.

    Compared to the fifth level of Qi refining, his meridians were more than twice as solid at this moment, and the capacity of his Dantian Qi sea was more than five times expanded.

    "There is such a big change in just one floor, which is far greater than the gap between the fourth and fifth floors..."

    Su Mu's face was full of emotion, he clenched his fists and felt that his whole body was full of strength.

    "With my current physical condition, even if the tomb fails as expected, it shouldn't take long to break through the seventh level. There won't be bottlenecks at every level."

    Su Mu was full of longing, as if he had seen the day when the foundation would be built in the future.

    He lowered his head and looked at the stone platform where he was sitting, and said to himself: "As long as we enter the inner gate and have the spirit gathering array, we will be able to enter the country much faster."

    In the outer door, it is said to be a training room, but it is actually a relatively secret stone room. Only the inner door training room is equipped with formations that can gather the spiritual energy of heaven and earth to assist training.

    "Bang bang bang~" A rapid knock on the door suddenly sounded.

    Su Mu turned his head to look at Shimen and heard Lu Yongzheng's voice: "Senior Brother Su! The Law Enforcement Hall has something to ask you!"

    His eyes flickered, he took a breath secretly, stood up and walked out of the living room to the stone room, and went to open the door.

    There were three people standing at the door. Except for Lu Yongzheng, the other two men were wearing black uniforms exclusive to the Law Enforcement Hall and looked relatively young.

    Su Mu was startled at first, then his eyes flashed with surprise, and he quickly raised his hands and said, "I wonder what the two senior brothers want from me?"

    Then, he waved his hand and said, "You three, please speak in the room."

    Two Law Enforcement Hall disciples entered the living room and scanned the indoor environment. One of the taller men said: "My name is Chen Jue, and he is Fang Yilong. I have been ordered to investigate the sudden death of Li Gou, a direct disciple of Wangyue Peak. I came here for routine questioning."

    Lu Yongzheng was still standing at the door, and there were many disciples in the courtyard looking this way.

    Su Mu glanced at the disciples who were probing their heads, and thought to himself: That's fine, the more people see him cooperating with the inquiry, the more magnanimous he will appear.

    "Okay, okay." He nodded in agreement, walked quickly to the table and started making tea, while saying, "You two senior brothers, feel free to ask."

    Chen Jue said, "There's no need to be busy," but he got straight to the point: "On the 31st of last month, from morning to midnight, where were you?"

    Su Mu held the teapot for a moment, deliberately swallowed, and thought for a while before saying: "I was in the warehouse at three o'clock in the morning, then returned to the courtyard, and returned to the practice room at about four o'clock in the morning. I didn't go out until nearly noon the next day."

    Chen Jue has a square face with narrow eyebrows and a serious smile that gives off a shrewd impression. When he heard this, he raised his eyebrows and asked: "At three o'clock in the morning? Why do you remember it so clearly?"

    Su Mu said "Oh": "The day before, I was taking inventory in the warehouse until late at night. After sorting out the accounts, I drank some wine and accidentally fell asleep. It wasn't until the next day that Junior Brother Lu came over to wake me up and told me the time."
